title: Proximity-verification policy
description: Committed proximity-verification options for this assembly: the set of detection bands a merchant offers (zone-wifi, nearby-ble, contact-nfc). Multi-valued — at template time the merchant declares which bands are acceptable; at runtime a buyer's commitment carries the bands required. An order without a proximity-policy clause has no proximity verification. Per-handoff nonce + signed witness payload travel in the sister schema figaro-proximity-proof-v1 at runtime.

fields.name: bands
fields.description: Required detection modalities. zone-wifi = same WiFi network. nearby-ble = BLE proximity. contact-nfc = physical NFC tap. At least one must be set when this clause is included in an agreement.
